milestone: T2 readiness — checkpoint/restart equivalence, L1 audit, shortened exposure, stability, seed ledger, comparison matrix

checkpoint_restart.state_carried: (X,H,Theta,D) via ContinuationState.dynamic + prng_key, event cursor via schedule re-instantiation, RNG via state.prng_key

l1_audit.populations: L1 is 8 VIP per area, 0 E/PV/SST — no L1_E exists (32 total)
l1_audit.evidence: Counter((area,layer,cell_type)) total L1=32 VIP; docs/L1_PROVENANCE.md, tests/test_l1_audit.py
l1_audit.semantics: VIP-only proxy for feedback target/geometry; area-specific override permitted

population_rates.per_classnote: E/PV/SST/VIP rates must stay finite; exclusion if any area >100 Hz sustained

h_state_domains.note: H_k conceptual ranges; kernel H_i is bounded [H_min,H_max] when HDP enabled

hdp_theta_domains.note: Only checked when HDP enabled; Θ bounded per channel

exclusion_rules: NaN or inf in V_m/spikes/sources/field => immediate exclusion
sustained global rate >100 Hz for >5s => exclusion (epileptic-like)
sustained V_m mean > -40 or < -80 for >10s => review
checkpoint/restart mismatch beyond tolerance => exclusion (ALWAYS-31 failure)
failure_rules: Shortened exposure (30-120s) must be finite and within bounds before authorizing ≥1000s
Any H/HDP out-of-bounds => fail T2 gate

shortened_exposure.purpose: exercise τ 0.1-100s partially to expose drift; not phenotype
shortened_exposure.H_1000_partial: 30s covers <3% of 1000s tau — full 1000s only in production 1200s
shortened_exposure.HDP: enable_hdp=False here; controller_B calibration pending — HDP validated via checkpoint test with population locality

checkpoint_identity.verification: uninterrupted vs restarted equivalence (ALWAYS-31/32) with tolerance rtol=1e-5 atol=1e-4 for V_m, exact for spikes

seed_ledger.description: seed = base + replicate_index for within-replicate pairing; omission vs intact share seed
seed_ledger.habituated_vs_naive: same seed set, different exposure history (Δ_exposure)
seed_ledger.intact_vs_omission: same seed per replicate, condition varies

resource_estimate.note: dt=0.5 reduces steps 5x (tested in milestone 01); production dt=0.1 is 5x cost — run on HPC with sharding if needed

comparison_matrix.delta_exposure: Δ_exposure = Y_omission^{post} - Y_omission^{pre}  (post after ≥1000s AAAB/BBBA, pre naive)
comparison_matrix.pooling_rule: DO NOT pool p2/p3/p4 until position dependence explicitly tested (Q11)

targets.label: sparse omission-linked spiking
targets.contrast: omission (AXAB/BXBA/RXRR etc) vs intact (AAAB/BBBA/RRRR) per position
targets.matching: within-replicate, same seed, intact vs omission at same p position
targets.test: per-unit rate comparison (omission slot [0,531] vs baseline [-250,-50]), FDR-corrected
targets.falsification: if fraction >=0.10 or 0, record as is — do not tune to force sparsity

targets.label: higher-order bias
targets.test: chi2 / enrichment (observed vs expected by area size)
targets.falsification: if V1 enriched, report; do not rewire to force frontal bias

targets.label: weak V1 population omission spiking
targets.estimand: V1 population PSTH omission vs intact
targets.contrast: V1 mean rate [0,531] omission vs intact
targets.test: paired t per ms + effect size (Cohen d)
targets.falsification: if V1 shows strong burst, report; not null

targets.label: frontal low-gamma omission effect
targets.estimand: LFP-like band power (20-50 Hz) omission vs intact

targets.label: gamma-rate coupling
targets.estimand: trial gamma power vs spike rate correlation

targets.label: weaker field coupling for omission-selective units
targets.estimand: spike-field coupling (SFC / gamma coupling) T1+ vs T1-
targets.contrast: T1+ vs T1- within same area

targets.label: absence of strong fixed between-area lead/lag
targets.contrast: all area pairs, omission and intact
targets.test: peak lag distribution, test for consistent non-zero lag
targets.falsification: if strong lead/lag found, report as positive — this T expects null

comparison_matrix.language_rule: lfp_proxy/csd_proxy remain proxy; never promote to physical LFP/CSD in manuscript
comparison_matrix.freeze_note: Frozen before production exposure; any expansion requires new version and review
